title: Simply Posh Dance Studio
specs: Incredible teachers providing outstanding technical training
Safe and loving environment promoting confidence and team unity
Dance shoes required for jazz, lyrical, and technical students
Ballet shoes required for ballet classes
Cheer and Hip Hop students can wear any athletic-type shoe
No shoes required for tumbling and acro students
Ballet dress code: black or dark leotard, pink ballet tights, ballet shoes
Hair slicked back out of face required for all classes
includes: Dance shoes for jazz, lyrical, and technical classes available for purchase
blurb: Students participate in dance, tumbling, and cheer classes with technical training and performance opportunities. The studio offers a safe and supportive environment with experienced teachers. Competition teams have additional requirements and fees.
extraNote: Tuition due 1st of every month with 5 day grace period · $15 late fee charged weekly after 6th if payment not made · One month advance email notice required to stop classes to avoid next month payment · Competition team tuition paid in full for June-May season; quitting mid-year still requires full payment · Parents only watch classes during last week of each month for last 5-10 minutes · Students wait in soda shop for teacher to get them; parents wait in soda shop · Absences during competition season must be excused by email; unexcused absences may prevent performing · Reception desk at the studio
